questions.q: What is a Trailhead Playground, according to this lesson?
options: A real, full Salesforce org created specifically for free hands-on practice
A read-only demo environment with no real Setup access
A shared org where all students edit the same data
A 30-day trial that always expires automatically
questions.explain: A Trailhead Playground is a real, full Salesforce org with full Setup access and your own data, not a limited demo.

questions.q: In the Create Playground dialog, what does this lesson recommend doing with the Name field?
options: Replace the randomly generated default with a name you'll actually recognize later
Leave it blank so Salesforce assigns one automatically
Use your email address as the playground name
It cannot be changed once typed
questions.explain: The lesson recommends naming the playground something recognizable, like "LTV Training Org," instead of keeping the random default name.

questions.q: Roughly how long does it take for a new Trailhead Playground to finish provisioning, per this lesson?
options: About three to four minutes
Roughly 24 hours
Under one second
About one week
questions.explain: The lesson states it typically takes three to four minutes from clicking Create to having a fully working org.

questions.q: Where does this lesson say you manage every playground (and connected org) you've created?
options: The Hands-On Orgs page at trailhead.salesforce.com/me/hands-on-orgs
Inside the Salesforce mobile app only
There is no central place to manage playgrounds
Only through Salesforce customer support
questions.explain: The Hands-On Orgs page lists every connected org and lets you Launch, Rename, Disconnect, or create another.

questions.q: What does this lesson say about a Trailhead Playground's expiration, compared to a trial org?
options: A playground doesn't expire on a fixed timer, as long as you log in occasionally to keep it active
A playground expires after exactly 30 days, identical to a trial org
A playground expires the moment you close your browser
A playground can never be disconnected or removed
questions.explain: Unlike a 30-day trial org, a Trailhead Playground stays free indefinitely as long as it's kept active with occasional logins.
